text: Everything optional. make_cell_meta() builds table (--cell-meta command line) extractor’s cells_qc.tsv labels: cell_type: cell types RNA (ATAC) annotation barcodes. Normal-tissue mode builds depth reference cell cells type, removes cell-type chromatin effects read depth; without cell types, cells form one reference. flat: cells known copy-number neutral (e.g. matched assay). Normal-tissue mode uses null cells null_cells = "features"; without use null_cells = "select" (caller selects null cells data). Tumour mode fits input depth allelic null ; normal reference pool normal clone caller finds cleans , cells. group: tumour mode, groups whose pseudobulk orients phase blocks (groups = "group"), e.g. spatial regions RNA clusters. text: Tumour mode needs read-phased alleles (allele votes drive clone discovery). Phase blocks longphase oriented blocks; caller orients per clone. title: Single-Cell Copy-Number Calling from Long-Read Single-Cell DNA Data
text: Single-cell copy-number calling SPLONGGET: single-cell long-read DNA sequencing every read carries 10x Multiome cell barcode sequenced Oxford Nanopore. scphasedcn combines read depth read-phased alleles (molecule covering phased heterozygous SNP votes haplotype), per cell region: normal tissue: rare, cell-private gains, losses copy-neutral LOH, thresholds calibrated null cells (1 false call per 1,000 null cell-regions), per cell cell pools; tumours: clone discovery, allele-specific clone copy-number profiles, likelihood assignment every cell, per-cell inherited / confirmed calls, input MEDICC2 trees. repository holds two packages, named scphasedcn, used together:

code: # 1. phased heterozygous SNPs (Clair3 + longphase on the pooled BAM; see vignette("scphasedcn-inputs")) scphasedcn select-hets --vcf sample.longphase.vcf.gz --loci 1000G_snvs_hg38.vcf.gz --out het_phased.vcf.gz  # 2. extraction (all chromosomes in parallel, then merge) scphasedcn run --bam sample.bam --barcodes barcodes.tsv.gz --fasta GRCh38.fa \     --snps het_phased.vcf.gz --phased --out results/sample/extract --jobs 8  # 3. calling CALL=$(Rscript -e 'cat(system.file("scripts", "call_scn.R", package = "scphasedcn"))')   # in the container: call_scn.R Rscript $CALL --dir results/sample/extract --out results/sample/caller --sex female --mode normal --null-cells select library(scphasedcn) res = call_scn("results/sample/extract", mode = "tumour", sex = "male") write_scphasedcn(res, "results/sample/caller")

title: scphasedcn 0.1.0
text: First public release scphasedcn. Normal-tissue mode (caller_normal()): null cells selected data, Student-t / beta-binomial nulls, fold-cross-validated thresholds 1 false call per 1,000 null cell-regions, per-cell pooled calls, events. Tumour mode (caller_tumour()): clone discovery, allele-specific clone copy-number states, likelihood assignment every cell, per-cell inherited confirmed calls, MEDICC2 input (medicc2_pieces(), medicc2_table()). write_scphasedcn() / read_scphasedcn(): flat result tables, parameters used (params.yaml) run notes. Command line: system.file("scripts", "call_scn.R", package = "scphasedcn"), --dir + --, sample yaml (inst/extdata/sample_template.yaml) --config + --sample. make_cell_meta(): cell metadata table (cell types, known copy-number-flat cells, groups) extractor’s cells_qc.tsv labels. hg38 centromere table ships package (hg38_centromeres()); chrX centromere masked like autosomal ones. simulate_scn() / write_sim_dataset(): simulated SPLONGGET-like data extractor’s layout. Vignettes: getting started, inputs (phasing recipe, extraction, cell metadata), outputs.
